description: This file defines the NavigationMenuBlock class, a Drupal plugin block that renders a navigation menu with configurable depth and level, utilizing menu tree manipulation and caching strategies.

classes.name: NavigationMenuBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin block class that provides a configurable navigation menu with depth control, leveraging menu tree APIs and cache management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the block with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns default configuration for the block, including level and depth.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the block configuration form, allowing depth options to be set.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to save configuration settings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the navigation menu, applying tree manipulators and setting cache contexts.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Returns module dependencies for cache invalidation.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts, excluding route-based active trail contexts.
